text: Shout triumphantly to the LORD, all the earth!
Serve the LORD with celebration! Come before him with shouts of joy!
Know that the LORD is God — he made us; we belong to him. [1] We are his people, the sheep of his own pasture.
Enter his gates with thanks; enter his courtyards with praise! Thank him! Bless his name!
Because the LORD is good, his loyal love lasts forever; his faithfulness lasts generation after generation.
